kit.cover_letter: I am writing to express my interest in the Backend Developer Intern position at Mogi I/O. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack and backend development experience, I am eager to contribute to your core video and image technology stack. During my professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready system utilizing Node.js, Express, and MySQL, implementing secure authentication and role-based access control. Additionally, my project work includes developing robust backend services using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, such as Zenvest, where I implemented JWT authentication, Joi-based request validation, and server-side API proxying. I have hands-on experience building real-world applications using Node.js and MongoDB, aligning directly with your core technical requirements. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical skills can support Mogi I/O's video delivery SaaS platform.
